question: **Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Belieif**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Belief**".
 
• "**Belief**" means a conviction or acceptance that something is true or real. (यह विश्वास या स्वीकृति कि कोई चीज़ सत्य या वास्तविक है)
 
 
• **For example-** *His belief in himself was what helped him achieve his goals.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Shout**", is spelt correctly and means to speak loudly or yell. (जोर से बोलना या चिल्लाना)
 
• Option 2: "**Salute**", is spelt correctly and means to show respect or honor. (आदर दिखाना)
 
• Option 4: "**Crops**", is spelt correctly and refers to plants that are grown for food or other purposes. (वे पौधे जो भोजन या अन्य प्रयोजनों के लिए उगाए जाते हैं)
